title: Page 4
content_zh:
他眸光微闪，不愿再去深究，就怕自欺欺人。
家族要雪冤，但至今朝堂的风向未明，朝中形势仍是贾家一派独大，而太子沉潜，只能以静制动，翻身之日遥遥无期，而他身负重责，又怎能谈儿女私情？
沈谅趁夜来到另一栋豪华宅院里，与何忠下棋，两人都是汤绍玄的心腹及亲信，随着白子、黑子落在棋盘上，两人也谈了很多。
他们知道少爷心里有多大的怨恨不平，只是他逼自己不去想，从进到青雪镇的第一天开始，他就殚精竭虑地为家族的未来、为太子筹谋，不让自己停下来，好似唯有如此才能够活下去，他活得太抑郁，他们无法劝说，担忧不已。
幸老天爷垂怜，让少爷遇上夏娘子。
这段日子，少爷不再那么冷漠，脸上线条不再紧绷，偶而想起什么，俊脸上还会露出一抹笑容，即使很淡，但他们仍看得出那是由内散发而出的愉悦，对这种变化乐见其成。
时间流逝，直到结束这场不分上下的棋局，沈谅才坦承地说：「稍早前，我多嘴一问，惹得少爷不快，忠叔可别步我后尘，在少爷面前提及夏娘子。」
「夏娘子是个好的，我明白。」
沈谅离开后，何忠走到一座书柜前，拿出其中一本厚厚的砖块书，
这是从遥远京城捎来的信，他已
摊开信纸，最后一段便是他的依仗——
「……经此大难，我祈望老天爷垂怜，让他能遇上一个善良的好姑娘陪伴在侧，若老天爷真应我心中祈求，忠叔便搭把手推上一把，他心思重，责任重，我不愿看他一人孤军奋斗，有个小姑娘在乎他吃得好不好，穿得暖不暖，知心知情，若是还能生个娃儿，延续子嗣，那便更好，至于大仇能不能得报？我相信苍天有眼……」
翌日，何忠在夏家食堂关门后，登门了。
夏羽柔看着眼前年已六旬，精神矍铄的老爷子，又看看他身后两名小厮，客客气气地说：「不好意思，我们已经关店了。」
何忠虽然是采石场大总管，但为人低调，除了采石场的工人，鲜少有人见过他，更别提离开青雪镇多年的夏羽柔，她没见过他，以为他是新客人。
「我知道，我是为了绍玄来的。」他是掐准时间过来，就是不想与少爷打照面。
片刻之后，两名小厮被留在门外，两人在食堂内坐下，夏羽柔为彼此倒了茶。
夏羽柔在听完何忠的自我介绍后，才知道他的身分，但她不明白对方为何要因为汤绍玄来找自己。
何忠开始娓娓道来汤绍玄的过往，而这个版本，夏羽柔……不，应该是对汤绍玄关注过的人都听过。
因为镇上三朵花加骆玉玫都想嫁给他，家里长辈便派人去查汤绍玄，这有人查，就有人说，一来一往，老百姓都听了不少内容。

何忠说，汤绍玄原本是一名京城衙役，他奉令跟其他官差押解一批流放女犯，与领头官差起了冲突，还不止一次，于是领头官差最后将他解职，不必回京了。
大略说完这一段，何忠又说起汤绍玄的身世，「绍玄其实也是大户人家出身，因是庶子，爹不疼，当家主母厌恶，姨娘早逝，自然不被看重，为了生活，他只能去当个衙役。」
她恍然大悟，难怪，他长了一张贵气的脸蛋，气质同样贵重。可惜了，是妾的孩子，一定被打压得很惨，才得自己挣钱。
夏羽柔有一段时间很迷看话本子，马上想像一些庶子被嫡母、嫡兄弟姊妹虐待的画面，她的心一疼，难怪他总摆着一张冷漠的面瘫脸。
「这些事都是绍玄找上我时，跟我交代的家世背景。」何忠说。
她愣了愣，「他找上你？」
「是，他在这里人生地不熟，稍一打探，知道这镇上除了港口的工作机会最多，再来就是采石场，他要求见我，要求一份工作，我年纪大了，识人无数，问了几句，知道他是个有才气、有能力的人，事实证明，我也没看走眼，现在他住的那栋山中别院，可是他从我这里赚走的。」
他笑了笑，「不瞒夏娘子，从他接手采石场，短短几月，采石场的营利比往年都要高上一倍，这是我们间的赌约，他办到了，那栋别院归他。」
何忠愈说愈自豪，这身世背景虽有虚假，但利润这事可是铁打的事实。
夏羽柔也是听说过这件事的，但从何忠口里说出来，那就是事实，她听了也很开心，但听着听着，还是不明白他跟她说这些是为何？
「绍玄是个很好的男子。」何忠笑笑的给了总结。
她眨眨眼，呃——老人家刻意跑来对她一个女子说汤绍玄很好，不会是她以为的那个意思吧？
「老夫老家有句俗谚，『要抓住一个男人的心就要先抓住他的胃』，夏娘子，老夫不太会说话，也冒昧叨扰了，不担误你休息了。」
直到何忠走了，她还呆坐着。
直到叶嬷嬷进来喊她一声，她才回了神，眨眨眼，何总管这就走了？他是要她抓住汤绍玄？先是弟弟要让她嫁他，再来是何总管，他们就这么看好她？
话说她先前明明听到汤绍玄的名字就怕小命不保，怎么现在她心里却乐得很，嘴角上扬压不下来，这是心花怒放？
「阿柔啊，你脸怎么那么红？不会是染上风寒发烧吧？」叶嬷嬷着急了。
完了！夏羽柔双手摀着发烫脸颊，不会真的动春心了？
「我没事。」
天，这么娇嗲嗓音不是她发出的？她自己都起了鸡皮疙瘩了！

叶嬷嬷一只略微粗糙但温暖的手突然摸上她的额头，「没烧啊，怎么怪怪的？」
夏羽柔连忙拉下她的手，羞涩说：「我真的没事，嬷嬷怎么又回来了？」她已经下工好一会儿。
「我要去顾婆子那里拿东西，经过就见你门没关，这才进来的。」
夏羽柔要她快去拿，就怕她追问，送走叶嬷嬷后，她继续呆坐，一会儿笑，一会儿皱眉，一会儿摇头晃脑，一会儿又搥搥额头。
没错，她要把自己打醒。
她是疯了吗？还真想跟汤绍玄怎么样？她忘了秤秤自己的斤两了！
第九章 关心则乱出马救人(1)
爱情来得太快，夏羽柔就算把自己额头打肿了，也不能否认这个残酷事实，只好很自欺欺人的告诉自己，汤绍玄不知道就好了，她喜欢上他，他也不会少块肉，不过是坐实她先前追他的事情罢了。
她去厨房做了小点心，提着点心就去了沈家。
再过几天，沈阿莲就要当新娘了。
沈阿莲还没嫁人，心思却已偏往婆家，早早请她这名厨艺高手为喜宴掌厨。
阿春家境不好不坏，虽吃得饱、穿得暖，但要日日吃肉定然是不行，所以夏羽柔这一趟也是来确定当日菜单，方便阿春家照单买食材。
两方说好，一方出手艺，一方出食材，夏羽柔不拿工钱，这份厨艺就是她送给最好朋友的贺礼。
因沈阿莲不识字，夏羽柔解释并念了菜单。
沈阿莲对菜单很满意，她吃着小甜糕，看着夏羽柔，觉得她有些不一样，这是来自手帕交的直觉，「你怎么了？我听我阿爹说，汤爷做了阿晨的夫子，跟你也很好，阿晨前阵子打零工的钱也拿到了，你还有什么烦心事？」
content_en:
His eyes flashed slightly, and he didn't want to delve deeper for fear of deceiving himself.
The family wants to avenge their grievances, but the direction of the court is still unclear. The situation in the court is still dominated by the Jia family, and the prince is in hiding, so he can only stop by silence. The day of turning over is far away, and he has heavy responsibilities, how can he talk about the personal relationship between his children?
Shen Liang came to another luxurious house at night and played chess with He Zhong. Both of them were Tang Shaoxuan's confidants. As the white and black stones fell on the chessboard, the two talked a lot.
They knew how much resentment and injustice the young master had in his heart, but he forced himself not to think about it. From the first day he entered Qingxue Town, he devoted all his energy to planning for the future of the family and the prince, and would not let himself stop, as if this was the only way he could survive. He lived too depressed, and they could not persuade them, and they were worried.
Fortunately, God showed mercy and allowed the young master to meet Madam Xia.
During these days, the young master is no longer so cold, and the lines on his face are no longer tight. Occasionally, when he thinks of something, a smile will appear on his handsome face. Even if it is very light, they can still see that it is the joy radiating from within, and they are happy to see this change.
Time passed, and it was not until the end of this neck-and-neck chess game that Shen Liang said frankly: "Earlier, I made the young master unhappy by asking too many questions. Uncle Zhong, please don't follow in my footsteps and mention Lady Xia in front of the young master."
"Ms. Xia is a good person, I understand."
After Shen Liang left, He Zhong walked to a bookcase and took out one of the thick brick books.
This is a letter sent from the distant capital. He has
Opening up the letter, the last paragraph is what he relies on——
"...After this catastrophe, I hope that God will have mercy on him and let him meet a kind and good girl to accompany him. If God really answers my prayer, Uncle Zhong will give me a hand. He has a lot of thoughts and responsibilities, and I don't want to see it. He is fighting alone, and there is a little girl who cares about whether he eats well, wears warm clothes, and knows everything about him. If he can still have a baby and continue his heirs, that would be better. As for whether the big revenge can be repaid, I believe that the sky has eyes..."
The next day, He Zhong came to the door after the Xia family cafeteria closed.
Xia Yurou looked at the energetic old man in his sixties before her, then at the two boys behind him, and said politely: "Sorry, we have closed the shop."
Although He Zhong is the general manager of the quarry, he is low-key. Except for the workers in the quarry, few people have seen him, let alone Xia Yurou, who has been away from Qingxue Town for many years. She has never seen him and thought he was a new guest.
"I know, I'm here for Shao Xuan." He came at the right time, but he just didn't want to meet the young master.
After a while, the two boys were left outside the door. They sat down in the cafeteria, and Xia Yurou poured tea for each other.
Xia Yurou only knew He Zhong's identity after listening to his self-introduction, but she didn't understand why he came to find her because of Tang Shaoxuan.
He Zhong began to talk about Tang Shaoxuan's past, and this version, Xia Yurou... no, everyone who paid attention to Tang Shaoxuan should have heard it.
Because the three flowers in the town and Luo Yumei all wanted to marry him, the elders in the family sent people to check on Tang Shaoxuan. Some people checked, and some said, the people heard a lot about it.
He Zhong said that Tang Shaoxuan was originally a government official in the capital. He was ordered to escort a group of exiled female prisoners with other officials, but he clashed with the leading official more than once, so the leading official finally dismissed him and no longer had to return to Beijing.
After briefly talking about this paragraph, He Zhong then talked about Tang Shaoxuan's life experience, "Shaoxuan actually came from a wealthy family. Because he was a concubine, his father didn't care for him, his mother hated him, and his aunt died young, so he was naturally not valued. In order to survive, he could only work as a government servant."
She suddenly realized that it was no wonder that he had a noble face and an equally noble temperament. It's a pity that he is a concubine's child, so he must have been severely suppressed and had to earn his own money.
Xia Yurou was obsessed with watching it for a whileFrom the storybook, she immediately imagined some scenes of a bastard being abused by his aunt's mother, brothers and sisters, and her heart ached. No wonder he always had a cold and paralyzed face.
"These are the family background that Shaoxuan told me when he approached me," He Zhong said.
She was stunned, "He came to you?"
"Yes, he is not familiar with the place here. After a little research, he learned that this town has the most job opportunities besides the port, and then the quarry. He asked to see me and asked for a job. I am old and know many people. After asking a few questions, I knew that he was a talented and capable person. Facts have proved that I did not make a mistake. He made money from me in the mountain villa where he lives now."
He smiled and said, "To be fair to Madam Xia, in just a few months since he took over the quarry, the quarry's profit has doubled compared to previous years. This is the bet between us. If he fulfills his promise, the villa belongs to him."
He Zhong became more and more proud as he spoke. Although his background was false, profit was an ironclad fact.
Xia Yurou had also heard about this matter, but when He Zhong said it, it was the truth. She was very happy to hear it, but as she listened, she still didn't understand why he told her this.
"Shaoxuan is a very good man." He Zhong concluded with a smile.
She blinked, uh - the old man came to her on purpose to tell a woman that Tang Shaoxuan was very good. He didn't mean what she thought he meant, right?
"There is a proverb in my hometown, 'To capture a man's heart, you must first capture his stomach.' Madam Xia, I'm not very good at talking, so I'm going to bother you. I won't bother you to rest."
She still sat there blankly until He Zhong left.
It wasn't until Grandma Ye came in and called her that she came back to her senses, blinked, and wondered why Mr. He was leaving now? Did he want her to catch Tang Shaoxuan? First, the younger brother wanted her to marry him, and then it was Manager He. Are they so optimistic about her?
By the way, she was clearly afraid of her life when she heard Tang Shaoxuan's name before, but now she is so happy that the corners of her mouth can't be suppressed. Is this because she is so happy?
"Ah Rou, why are your faces so red? Could it be that you have a cold or a fever?" Grandma Ye was worried.
It’s over! Xia Yurou covered her hot cheeks with both hands. Could it be that she was really having sex?
"I'm fine."
Oh my god, isn't that the coquettish voice coming from her? She even got goosebumps herself!
A slightly rough but warm hand from Grandma Ye suddenly touched her forehead, "You don't have a fever, why is it so weird?"
Xia Yurou quickly took her hand and said shyly, "I'm really fine. Why is grandma back again?" She had been off work for a while.
"I was going to get something from Mrs. Gu. When I passed by, I saw your door was open, so I came in."
Xia Yurou asked her to get it quickly, fearing that she would ask questions. After seeing off Nanny Ye, she continued to sit blankly, laughing sometimes, frowning, shaking her head, and beating her forehead.
Yes, she was going to wake herself up.
Is she crazy? What do you really want to do with Tang Shaoxuan? She forgot to weigh herself!
Chapter 9 If you care, you will go out to save others (1)
Love came so fast. Even if her forehead was swollen, Xia Yurou couldn't deny the cruel fact. She could only deceive herself and tell herself that it would be fine if Tang Shaoxuan didn't know. If she fell in love with him, he would not lose a piece of flesh. It was just to confirm her previous pursuit of him.
She went to the kitchen to make snacks and went to Shen's house with the snacks in hand.
In a few days, Alian Shen will be a bride.
Shen Alian was not married yet, but her thoughts were already towards her husband's family, so she invited her, a master in cooking, to cook the wedding banquet early.
Achun's family is not in a bad situation. Although they are well fed and clothed warmly, it is definitely not possible to eat meat every day, so Xia Yurou is here to confirm the menu for the day so that Achun's family can buy the ingredients according to the order.
The two parties agreed that one would provide the craftsmanship and the other would provide the ingredients. Xia Yurou would not get paid. This cooking skill was given to her best friend.Congratulations.
Because Shen Alian was illiterate, Xia Yurou explained and read the menu.
Shen Alian was very satisfied with the menu. She ate the sweet cake and looked at Xia Yurou, feeling that there was something different about her. This was the intuition from the handkerchief, "What's wrong with you? I heard from my father that Mr. Tang became Achen's wife and he is very good with you. Achen also got the money from his part-time job a while ago. What else is bothering you?"
